summary: BeLive Holdings, a Singapore-incorporated Nasdaq-listed technology group, furnished a Form 6-K, the foreign-private-issuer equivalent of a US current report, comprising its interim financial statements for the six months ended June 30, 2026 under IFRS. The XBRL exhibit tags show segment revenue by customer, property, plant and equipment, right-of-use assets, software development costs and receivables aging. No transaction, stake, price, premium, advisor or board recommendation is disclosed. This is a routine periodic reporting event with no special-situations mechanics or risk-arb angle to trade.
